description: This file contains helper functions for F1AP configuration, including creation of measurement timing buffers, cell info, system info, and setup requests for a 5G NR network, specifically related to F1 interface configuration in a DU (Distributed Unit) context.

methods.name: make_asn1_meas_time_cfg_buffer
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 measurement timing configuration buffer based on DU cell configuration.

methods.name: make_f1ap_du_cell_info
methods.description: Generates cell information structure for F1AP message from DU cell configuration.

methods.name: make_f1ap_du_sys_info
methods.description: Generates system information for F1AP message from DU cell configuration.

methods.name: fill_f1_setup_request
methods.description: Fills an F1 setup request message with parameters and cell configurations.
